name: Marineo
source:
“If you’re a gentleman, then this is the moment when you should gently extend a helping hand!”

A doll of a silver-haired girl that follows Maya and guides Nayuta. She is slightly airheaded, and her way of speaking ends with the refined “~desu no.” While Marineo and Jajas switch between playing the fool and the straight man depending on the situation, Marineo is generally the one handling the jokes.
